summary: Three submittable delay=1 alphas mined on WorldQuant Brain, avoiding TOP3000. All pass ALL in-sample submit checks; pairwise PnL correlations all < 0.7 (the self-correlation submit limit), so all three can coexist in a submitted pool. Not actually submitted (per instruction: check-only).

factor_3_revision.rationale: Analyst forward-EPS revision momentum (analysts raising estimates predicts returns) — a signal family orthogonal to both value factors — minus a light 1-week reversal. Revision is double-weighted so the alpha is revision-dominant, giving near-zero correlation to the value champion (-0.151) and low correlation to factor 2 (0.352).

factor_2_decorrelated.rationale: Earnings-yield value (ebit/cap, ts_rank-smoothed 40d) minus a down-weighted 1-week price reversal. The reversal leg injects PnL orthogonal to the slow fundamental champion, pulling the cross-alpha correlation down to 0.599 while LIFTING Sharpe to 1.60. The 0.7 weight is the sweet spot: heavier reversal lowers correlation but its turnover erodes fitness.

champion.rationale: Orthogonal value + profitability composite: cashflow-yield (cashflow_op/cap) captures cheap stocks; ROE (ebit/equity) captures quality. Each leg is ts_rank-smoothed over 40d to stabilize the quarterly fundamental signal, then cross-sectionally ranked and summed equally. No Alpha101 / classical-template reuse.

checks.SELF_CORRELATION: PENDING -> ~0 on fresh account (no prior submitted alphas); /correlations/self returns empty

runner_up.note: Lower turnover (0.119) and higher fitness (1.08), but sub-universe Sharpe 0.76 sits exactly at the 0.76 limit (marginal). Champion chosen for its comfortable margin and cleaner equal-weight form.

method_notes: Raw cross-sectional fundamental ratios are weak (~0.3 Sharpe) on this account's IS window 2019-2023.
Wrapping a valuation ratio in ts_rank(.,40) lifts it to ~1.0 Sharpe.
TOP1000 is the sweet spot here; TOP500/TOP200 were weaker (opposite of some public notes).
Adding an ORTHOGONAL profitability signal (ROE=ebit/equity) to a cashflow-yield value signal is what breaks past SH 1.25 / FIT 1.0.
All numbers are from WorldQuant Brain /simulations (authoritative), not the local yfinance proxy.
